netflix-red.$description: Netflix Red — Brand logo, primary CTAs, active indicators — the single, powerful accent that drives action and defines identity.

feature-card-gradient.$description: Feature Card Gradient — Background for secondary feature cards, adding a subtle, deep-space dimensionality without using shadows.

deep-space.$description: Deep Space — Primary page and section backgrounds, creating a pure black canvas for content.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Subtle background surfaces, component backgrounds.

slate.$description: Slate — Borders on inputs and interactive elements.

ash.$description: Ash — Placeholder text in input fields.

silver.$description: Silver — Footer links and secondary, non-critical body copy.

chalk-white.$description: Chalk White — All primary headings, body text, and icon fills.

netflix-sans.$description: The singular typographic voice of the brand. Its slightly condensed and geometric form scales from 13px body copy to massive 56px+ headlines, delivering information with clarity and confidence.
